latestVersion.changelog:
AI Caption Generator for Video — Initial Release

- Instantly generate and embed auto-synced captions for video files (up to 1080p) via a simple chat interface.
- Automated session setup and free token provision for new users (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Fast cloud GPU processing—30–90 seconds typical turnaround per clip, with shorter videos processing faster.
- Support for English and Spanish captioning, multi-track edits, and batch file uploads.
- Easy export as MP4 and quick access to credits, status, and timeline previews.
- Handles a variety of formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.) and provides clear feedback on errors and progress.
